player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm iseqdac {player_id} deg {num_rounds} n wuzzar n IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Yal wuzzar, ḥuddu umḍan ger {min_guess} d {max_guess}.
Mi d-yekka wuzzar, lqedd n tigawt (2/3)x(tamḍant n wuzzar),
d iseqdac i d-yewwiḍ lqedd n tigawt iqeddac wuzzar-nni.
Ṣṣayḍiḍ lḥuddu-nnek deg tawlaft '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴳⵉ ⵓⴽⵛⵓⵎ; ⵙⵙⵓⴼⵖ ⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏⴰⵙⵜ ⵏⵏⵓⵏ [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Tafsa d ussuɣ nnek tettuɣal deg wakud ad yili gar {min_guess} d {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Amɣay 0 yessufɣet {guess0}; Amɣay 1 yessufɣet {guess1}. Merra, anadi d win: {target}.
